instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Record what happened to a job one of my AIs took: finish it with its result, say it failed, give it back, say what blocks it, take back one I sent, or remove it", and give it as (The acting AI's record id); id (The job's record id); action.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:change-an-ai-job and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads the ai-job record `id` and makes the move `action` names, by the rules in read-data/ai-work.json: finish (the taker; needs result, may add summary) and fail (the taker; needs result: why) end it; release gives it back to waiting (the taker, or anyone once it is held longer than the stale-take time; `because` says why); stuck says what blocks it (any AI, so a watcher can flag it; needs words) and unstuck clears that (any AI); withdraw takes back a job still waiting (its sender; `because`); remove deletes the record (its sender, or anyone once it is finished).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: ai-job (records:read, records:write).
